fieldData.excerpt: In a significant move to fortify the emerging Radix ecosystem, Hacken.io, a renowned Blockchain Security Auditor, has announced that they will be supporting audits of dApps built with Scrypto.
fieldData.main-content:
In a significant move to fortify the emerging Radix ecosystem, Hacken.io, a renowned Blockchain Security Auditor, has announced that they will be supporting audits of dApps built with Scrypto. Seeing the emerging opportunity presented by the Radix Mainnet Babylon Upgrade that will bring a radically better User and developer experience, Hacken have also announced a special offer for Radix projects. Dapp audits can be an important tool in any project's go to market strategy, and when combined with Radix's secure and intuitive user and developer experience help provide a significantly better security landscape within the crypto space.

Introducing Hacken:

With an impressive track record of 0 rekt cases among 567 audited projects in 2022 across Avalanche, BNB, Cronos, Polygon, DAO Maker and Enterprise Ethereum Alliance, Hacken has established itself as a trusted name in the field of cybersecurity. 

With over six years of experience and a team of highly skilled professionals, Hacken has catered to the cybersecurity needs of 1,200 satisfied clients and formed 200 strong partnerships. Their commitment to fast service provision has earned them a well-deserved reputation in the industry.

Hacken offers a comprehensive range of solutions to address various cybersecurity challenges. Some of the notable services provided by Hacken include Smart Contract Audit, Blockchain Protocol Audit, Web & Mobile App and API Penetration Testing, dApp Audit, Bug Bounty, Proof of Reserves, CCSS Audit, and Tokenomics Audit. By working with Hacken, Radix Builders can leverage these services to enhance their security posture and mitigate potential risks.

Special Offer for the Radix Community:

As part of this partnership, Hacken extends a compelling offer to developers utilizing Hacken's services, including:

  • Up to 20% discount: This discount allows Radix ecosystem projects to access Hacken's cutting-edge security solutions at a reduced cost.
  • Priority queue: Radix ecosystem projects will receive priority service, reducing waiting time for audits. The average waiting time for priority queue projects is only 10-15 days.
  • 4-stage methodology: Hacken employs a four-stage methodology to support the quality of their audits. This approach guarantees a thorough review of code to detect even the most elusive vulnerabilities.
  • Team of auditors: Hacken assigns a team of three auditors to review the code, leveraging their expertise to uncover hard-to-detect issues.
  • Vulnerability fixes and fee optimization recommendations: Upon detecting vulnerabilities, Hacken provides detailed recommendations on how to address them and optimize fees.
  • Bug Bounty program and triage service: The first 20 projects from the Radix ecosystem will receive free placement in HackenProof's Bug Bounty program, allowing them to harness the power of ethical hackers to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Integration with leading platforms: Hacken facilitates integrations with CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, and top centralized exchanges (CEXes), further enhancing the visibility and credibility of Radix projects.
  • Cybersecurity score: Radix ecosystem projects can benefit from visibility of their cybersecurity scorethrough a free listing on CER.live.
  • Strengthened public image: By availing themselves of Hacken's services, Radix ecosystem projects can bolster their public image as a "security-first" ecosystem within the Web3 landscape.
  • Marketing support and educational activities: Hacken provides marketing support on platforms such as Twitter, LinkedIn, and Discord. Additionally, joint marketing initiatives and educational content by Hacken's R&D staff, including AMAs (Ask Me Anything) and educational resources, further enrich the Radix ecosystem.

‍

Hacken’s enthusiastic support of the Radix ecosystem is an important milestone that strengthens the security infrastructure supporting the fast-growing Radix ecosystem. With Hacken's proven expertise in blockchain security and the radically better user and developer experience provided by Radix, the Radix ecosystem is in a strong position to drive growth, and provide a more secure environment for projects running on Radix. 

How to redeem offer and request services from Hacken

1. Contact Vlady Che via Telegram @vlady_hacken or email v.che@hacken.io

2. Briefly explain your need, which services you request, expected timelines, and include your projects website and Twitter handle.

3. The reply with the next steps will follow within one business day
